sources.entry: 19. Midjourney Tips on Reddit - Reddit post with additional tips for Midjourney users.

summary.name: Midjourney Tips on Reddit
summary.one_liner: A Reddit comment thread in r/midjourney discussing Midjourney's uneven rendering of certain artists' styles and a community-made artist reference sheet.
use_cases: Finding community-made Midjourney artist style reference sheets
Understanding why some artist names produce unexpected results in Midjourney
Learning community workarounds for artist style prompting
summary.what_it_does: This is a Reddit comment thread on a post in r/midjourney that shares an artist/style reference sheet. Commenters discuss the sheet's anime and cartoon results, the --test versus --testp settings, and why Midjourney sometimes pulls artist portraits or name fragments rather than an artist's actual style. The thread points to other community-maintained artist lists, including a Google Sheets guide and a Google Sites page. The page itself does not describe a product, and the author says the sheet is not affiliated with any official source.
notable: Discussion of Midjourney artist-name prompts pulling portraits or decomposed name fragments
Links to community-maintained artist reference sheets
Comparison of Midjourney --test and --testp model output
caveats: Discussion is anecdotal; the commenter states the name-decomposition explanation is a guess without data
Reference sheets are community-made and not official Midjourney resources
Some sheets listed are incomplete (e.g., anime/cartoon sheet described as least helpful)
